easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
